description: Match up to 1,000 names at once (for example a spreadsheet column). Each item can carry its own state hint. Results are in the same order as the input.

level.description: 1 for states, 2 for localities; leave out if unknown

names.description: The names to match, each with its own optional state hint (1 to 1,000)

name.description: The place name as written, in Arabic or English

state_hint.description: The state this name is in, as a name in any spelling or a P-code such as SD02

name: match_place_names
title: Match many Sudanese place names
